description: This file defines the configuration parsing logic for 'TalkModeGateway' in the OpenClaw project. It includes a data structure `TalkModeGatewayConfigState` representing the configuration state, and an enum `TalkModeGatewayConfigParser` responsible for parsing configuration snapshots to produce this state, with fallback mechanisms.

classes.name: TalkModeGatewayConfigState
classes.description: A struct representing the current configuration state of the TalkModeGateway including provider info, payload normalization, voice settings, model ID, output format, and timeout.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a configuration snapshot to produce a `TalkModeGatewayConfigState`, resolving values from the snapshot, environment variables, and defaults, with logic for prioritization and fallback.

methods.name: fallback
methods.description: Provides a fallback configuration state when parsing fails or fallback is needed, mainly setting default provider and optional voice and API key from environment variables.
